text: あなたも　おはか　まいりに　きたの？
note: おはかまいり (ohaka-mairi) is the Japanese custom of visiting a family grave to clean it and pray, done especially at Obon and the equinoxes.
claim: Ohaka-mairi, visiting family graves, is customarily done in Japan at Obon and the equinox weeks (higan).

check.quote: Families typically visit graves during お盆(ぼん) (mid-August), お彼岸(ひがん) (equinox weeks in March and September), and 命日(めいにち) (death anniversaries).
